items.title: Eblen Rau Interview, 1974-05-27
items.q: An old man, Duke, the original James P. Duke of the tobacco company, American Tobacco Company, sent down to Mr. Irby

ctx.x: I hate to keep skipping around but I get confused on some of these people that you played with. Did you ever know Guy Lahneman? I knew Guy very well, yeah. Who was he?

He played an instrument that he made out of a shoebox and a car horn. And he could play the damn thing like nobody's business. And he would sing too. I mean he had a sort of a voice like Edmond Sushant. It was one of these grating sort of thing. But he knew how to put it over. They had a wonderful sense of rhythm. And that was Guy's instrument. They had a wooden box about that big with a shoehorn. Not a shoehorn. A car bell nailed onto the damn thing. Between the wooden box and the car bell that was Guy made his…
What about Eugene Jinx Dybal? Did you know him? I may not be pronouncing that name right.
